items.name: AKM Assault Rifle
items.description: An Onotos Production modified AKM assault rifle, currently the most popular and influential weapon in the AK series. Uses 7.62x39mm ammo.

items.name: M4A1 Assault Rifle
items.description: An International Firearms M4A1 assault rifle. Compact and lightweight, it boasts impressive range and power, along with a high rate of fire, making it very versatile. Uses 5.56x45mm ammo.

items.name: FAL Assault Rifle
items.description: The well-known FA Corp FAL assault rifle. Solid and reliable, it is user-friendly, easy to disassemble, and comes equipped with a unique gas regulator. Uses 7.62x51mm ammo and is highly acclaimed in military and civilian circles.

items.name: H416 Assault Rifle
items.description: This prestigious Helka Corp assault rifle features a short-stroke gas piston system and free float handguard. It is easy to use and can be modified with a variety of accessories. Uses 5.56x45mm ammo.

items.name: DT MDR Assault Rifle
items.description: A modular, multi-caliber, compact bullpup rifle from Break Point Zero. It features a high-strength aluminum alloy upper receiver, a barrel with 5 grooves and a right-hand twist, and a lower receiver made from injection molded fiberglass reinforced plastic. Uses 5.56x45mm ammo.

items.name: AK-102 Assault Rifle
items.description: A compact rifle made by Gorod with a side folding stock. An export variant of the AK series suitable for mid-range combat environments. Uses 5.56x45mm ammo.

items.name: AK-74N Assault Rifle
items.description: The AKM Evo assault rifle was developed by Gorod Industrial to accommodate a new type of ammunition. It features a rail on the left side of the receiver for the mounting of optical scopes. Uses 5.45x39mm ammo.

items.name: AKS-74U Assault Rifle
items.description: The AKS-74U is a scaled-down version of the AKS-74 assault rifle, developed by Gorod Industrial for troops in armored vehicles and paratroopers. A close-range defensive weapon. Uses 5.45x39mm ammo.

items.name: AUG Assault Rifle
items.description: The AUG is an automatic military rifle produced by Helka Corp. The first assault rifle to use a modular, bullpup design. Uses 5.56x45mm ammo.

items.name: F2000 Assault Rifle
items.description: An FA bullpup assault rifle with a glossy exterior. Streamlined and compact, it ejects spent cases after every three to four shots. Uses 5.56x45mm ammo.

items.name: AR-57 Assault Rifle
items.description: The AR-57 assault rifle from Break Point Zero, based on the AR series. Upper receiver modification enables the use of P90 magazine and 5.7x28mm ammo. Extremely fast rate of fire and high precision.

items.name: ACE31 Assault Rifle
items.description: A new ACE31 assault rifle from FA Corp. Based on the AK series, it incorporates multiple improvements to external parts and accessories. Performs reliably. Ergonomic and precise. Uses 7.62x39mm ammo.

items.name: AEK Assault Rifle
items.description: An AEK assault rifle manufactured by Gorod. It incorporates a balanced rotating closed bolt system to provide increased stability during auto fire. Uses 7.62x39mm ammo.

items.name: AN-94 Assault Rifle
items.description: An outstanding AN-94 assault rifle produced by Gorod. With a unique 2-round burst mode firing at 1,800 rounds per minute, it has the accuracy of a bolt-action rifle. Uses 5.45x39mm ammo.

items.name: FAMAS Assault Rifle
items.description: The FAMAS Assault Rifle is one of FA Corp's most well-known products. With a compact bullpup structure, a clip designed for the cheek, and a bolt installed on the stock, it has a locked standby design and three shooting modes: single shot, 3-round burst, and fully automatic. Uses 5.56x45mm ammo.

items.name: SCAR-L Assault Rifle
items.description: A new assault rifle developed by FA Corp that's specifically designed for special operations and can handle complex and changeable combat environments. It has a modular design and different module accessories that can be switched up to suit the style of combat. Uses 5.56x45mm ammo.

items.name: T951 Assault Rifle
items.description: The T951 assault rifle has a bullpup-style design, offering good stability and high precision. Due to its shorter chassis, it performs well in close and mid-range combat. Uses 5.8x42mm ammo.

items.name: T03 Assault Rifle
items.description: The T03 assault rifle was designed with an optimized modern structure to handle a diverse range of battlefields and all manner of military needs. Uses 5.8x42mm ammo.

items.name: SG550 Assault Rifle
items.description: An advanced automatic rifle designed by FA Corp, this firearm features a traditional structure that offers high accuracy, but at the cost of mobility. Uses 5.56x45mm ammunition. Its opening shots are more accurate.

items.name: G3 Assault Rifle
items.description: A modernized assault rifle manufactured by Helka Corp, it is an automatic rifle featuring a roller-delayed blowback mechanism and utilizes 7.62x51mm ammunition.

items.name: AK12 Assault Rifle
items.description: Gorod's next generation assault rifle's design is based on the AK-74. All aspects of it have been modernized and the improvements ensure that it is both easier to use and more reliable, while boasting improved ergonomics.

items.name: MCX Assault Rifle
items.description: Helka's personal defense weapon uses 5.56mm caliber ammo and boasts tremendous firepower and amazing control. Its only weakness is its lack of accuracy.

items.name: T191 Assault Rifle
items.description: Unlike the previous generation's T951, the T191 has a conventional structure but uses advanced materials and manufacturing processes for improved performance, modularity, and expandability.

items.name: T-192 Short Assault Rifle
items.description: A short automatic rifle developed from the T-191. It has a shorter barrel, making it easier for mechanized infantry to carry and more effective in urban and close-quarters combat.

items.name: A545 Assault Rifle
items.description: This successor to the AEK rifle series retains the signature balanced recoil of the AEK and boasts a high rate of fire.

items.name: MP5 Micro SMG
items.description: A classic Helka Corp product, the MP5 micro SMG is outstanding in close combat. Used as a regulation weapon in many countries, it enjoys an excellent reputation. Uses 9x19mm ammo.

items.name: MPX Micro SMG
items.description: The MPX micro SMG uses a Helka modular design and features a Picatinny rail for the mounting of optical scopes. Uses 9x19mm ammo.

items.name: P90 Micro SMG
items.description: The P90 is an advanced micro SMG from FA Corp. It is the first personal defense weapon adapted to fire newly modified ammunition. Uses 5.7x28mm ammo.

items.name: Uzi Micro SMG
items.description: The Uzi submachine gun is a highly effective close-range tactical weapon. Lightweight, easy to use, inexpensive, and simple to manufacture, it is often used in urban warfare. Uses 9x19mm ammo.

items.name: UMP45 Micro SMG
items.description: Designed by Helka Corp, the UMP45 micro submachine gun features an open bolt blowback mechanism and rate reducer, increasing control at the cost of rate of fire. Uses .45 caliber ammo.

items.name: MP 40 Micro SMG
items.description: Designed with mass production in mind, this micro SMG provides high performance in a simple package. Uses 9x19mm ammo.

items.name: MAC-10 Micro SMG
items.description: The MAC-10 micro SMG is a well-known compact firearm with reliable action, made using high-strength steel stampings. Can be fitted with a suppressor. Uses .45 caliber ammo.

items.name: M3A1 Micro SMG
items.description: A low-cost submachine gun designed to accommodate growing demand, the M3 is also known as the "grease gun" due to its resemblance to a mechanic's tool. Uses .45 caliber ammo.

items.name: T79 Micro SMG
items.description: A lightweight and practical submachine gun featuring a simple design, compact size, high precision, and superior firepower at close range. Uses 7.62x25mm ammo.

items.name: QC61 Micro SMG
items.description: A new low-cost submachine gun with limited range, suited to close-range tactical environments. Supports a variety of accessories. Uses 7.62x25mm ammo.

items.name: MPF45 Micro SMG
items.description: An improved submachine gun designed by Helka. Lightweight and easy to use, this weapon is suited to close-range tactical environments. Uses .45 caliber ammo.

items.name: Vector 45 Micro SMG
items.description: The Break Point Zero Vector 45 micro SMG is suited to close-range tactical environments. A controllable and compact weapon system. Uses .45 caliber ammo.

items.name: T85 Micro SMG
items.description: Optimized T79 light submachine gun that features blowback self-loading, allows for single and full automatic fire, and can be fitted with a suppressor. Uses 7.62x25mm ammo.

items.name: Vector 9 Micro SMG
items.description: The Break Point Zero Vector 9 micro SMG is suited to close-range tactical environments. A controllable and compact weapon system. Uses 9x19mm ammo.

items.name: Banshee Submachine Gun
items.description: The Banshee submachine gun from Break Point Zero features softer recoil, higher accuracy, and reduced weight. Uses 5.7×28mm ammo.

items.name: SVDS Marksman Rifle
items.description: The highly regarded Gorod Industrial SVDS marksman rifle features a side folding stock and high rate of fire. Very reliable. Uses 7.62x54mm ammo.

items.name: VSS Marksman Rifle
items.description: A quiet, short-range marksman rifle specially designed for snipers by Gorod Industrial. It has very little muzzle flash and is capable of full automatic fire. Uses 9x39mm ammo.

items.name: Mk14 Marksman Rifle
items.description: The Break Point Zero Mk14 marksman rifle is a derivative of the M14 carbine. It can be fitted with optical scopes, night vision, and tactical accessories as the wielder needs. Uses 7.62x51mm ammo.

items.name: M110 Marksman Rifle
items.description: A new-gen compact semi-automatic marksman rifle manufactured by Break Point Zero. Compatible with all types of accessories, packed with features, and highly versatile. Uses 7.62x51mm ammo.

items.name: DBR Marksman Rifle
items.description: The DBR marksman rifle's double-barrel break-action design allows two rounds to be fired in rapid succession. It has a simple structure and excellent reliability. Uses 7.62x54mm bullets.

items.name: T88 Marksman Rifle
items.description: The T88 marksman rifle adopts a bullpup design, shortening its overall length and improving mobility. The straight stock also helps improve accuracy. Uses 5.8x42mm ammo.

items.name: U191 Marksman Rifle
items.description: A precision rifle based on the T191. It features a free-floating heavy barrel, lengthened line of sight, and improved accuracy. It comes with an adjustable day scope and a Picatinny rail.

items.name: Mosin-Nagant Bolt-Action Rifle
items.description: A Mosin-Nagant bolt-action rifle. Easy to manufacture, simple to use, and very reliable. Requires very little maintenance. Uses 7.62x54mm ammo.

items.name: AX50 Bolt-Action Rifle
items.description: An FA Corp long-range, high-powered bolt-action rifle that excels in long-range combat. Uses 12.7x99mm anti-materiel ammo.

items.name: AR-30 Bolt-Action Rifle
items.description: A new Break Point Zero high-caliber bolt-action rifle. Precise and reliable. Uses .338 Lapua Magnum ammo.

items.name: SJ16 Bolt-Action Rifle
items.description: An improved high-caliber rifle with a bolt-action mechanism. Provides high accuracy at long ranges. Uses .338 Lapua Magnum ammo.

items.name: M24 Bolt-Action Rifle
items.description: A well-known bolt-action rifle designed and produced by Break Point Zero. It integrates precision and power and boasts outstanding ergonomic properties. Uses 7.62x51mm ammo.

items.name: RPK-16 Light Machine Gun
items.description: This modernized Gorod Industrial light machine gun features superior firepower, high precision, and low recoil. Not to be underestimated. Uses 5.45x39mm ammo.

items.name: M870 Shotgun
items.description: The Flemington M870 pump-action shotgun provides good reliability and durability in extreme environments. Widely used for hunting and personal defense. Uses 12x70mm shells.

items.name: MP-133 Shotgun
items.description: A Gorod smoothbore shotgun with a unique slide stop mechanism. Reliable and durable. Mainly used for hunting. Uses 12x70mm shells.

items.name: S12K Shotgun
items.description: The Onotos Production S12K semi-automatic magazine-fed shotgun features high versatility and compatibility with a variety of accessories. Its built-in dust cover provides added reliability. Uses 12x70mm shells.

items.name: USAS-12 Shotgun
items.description: The Flemington USAS-12 shotgun employs a gas-operated design with semi-automatic and full-automatic fire options. It lays down sustained and powerful firepower. Uses 12x70mm shells.

items.name: SPR310 Shotgun
items.description: The SPR310 is a double-barreled shotgun from Onotos Production with over and under barrel configuration. A very popular shotgun that is commonly used for hunting.

items.name: SKS Carbine
items.description: Also known as the SKS 45, this semi-automatic carbine is reliable, durable, and more precise than the AK. It is easy to use and maintain, and the production costs are low. Uses 7.62x39mm ammo.

items.name: M14 Carbine
items.description: The M14 carbine features single shot precision, long range, and a sturdy chassis. It is used mainly for hunting, training, and competitions. Uses 7.62x51mm ammo.

items.name: M96 Carbine
items.description: The M96 carbine is pneumatically operated and has many special designs incorporated in the action and barrel, making it a very reliable semi-automatic rifle. It uses 5.56x45mm ammo.

items.name: Mini14 Carbine
items.description: The Mini14 carbine from International Firearms is based on the M14 rifle, but with lots of innovations and a new design that reduces the cost, making it a popular weapon among civilians. Uses 5.56x45mm ammo.

items.name: SA85M Carbine
items.description: A civilian-type carbine modeled after the AKM, made specifically for export. It can only support semi-automatic fire and uses the 7.62x39mm ammo.

items.name: BM59 Carbine
items.description: A carbine developed by the FA Corp in the early years. A detachable magazine can be fed into it, but that is now discontinued. It is still very popular due to its reliable performance. It uses 7.62x51mm ammo.

items.name: SVTU Carbine
items.description: The SVTU carbine manufactured by Onotos is a gas-operated carbine with magazine feeding that has remained popular to this day due to its reliability. Uses 7.62x54mm rounds.

items.name: M16 Carbine
items.description: The M16 carbine from Flemington is the most commonly manufactured weapon that fires 5.56x45mm rounds. It is capable of both firing semi-automatically and in 3-round bursts.

items.name: G17 Pistol
items.description: The Helka Corp G17 pistol employs Browning tilting barrel locking, and features auto switch. 40% of parts are made from engineering plastic. One of the most popular service weapons in the world. Uses 9x19mm ammo.

items.name: M9A3 Pistol
items.description: The FA M9A3 pistol, the newest variant in the M9 series of guns, features reliable action and a simple design. Uses 9x19mm ammo.

items.name: G18C Pistol
items.description: The G18C pistol, the latest improved model of the G17 by Helka, provides a full automatic firing mode, excellent reliability, and a rapid rate of fire. Uses 9x19mm ammo.

items.name: MP9 Micro SMG
items.description: The FA MP9 micro SMG features a compact design and high rate of fire, making it ideal for close combat. Uses 9x19mm ammo.

items.name: Desert Eagle Pistol
items.description: FA Corp's world-famous Desert Eagle provides impressive firepower at the cost of substantial recoil. Its complex design and low reliability make it unsuitable for harsh battlefields. Uses .44 caliber ammo.

items.name: T54 Pistol
items.description: Based on the TT1930/1933 pistol, this firearm is suitable for self-defense and close-range combat. Uses 7.62x25mm ammo.

items.name: T05 Pistol
items.description: The sleek and innovative T05 revolver features a compact design and responsive action. It is safe, reliable, and easy to maintain. Uses 9x19mm ammo.

items.name: M1911 Pistol
items.description: The M1911 semi-automatic's high caliber provides it with firepower that outclasses most pistols. It is also reliable, durable, and easy to repair. Uses .45 caliber ammo.

items.name: M45A1 Pistol
items.description: The International Firearms M45A1 pistol, a modification of the M1911, is suitable for close-range tactical environments. Uses .45 caliber ammo.

items.name: Gold Desert Eagle Pistol
items.description: The gold chassis on this FA Corp limited-edition Desert Eagle pistol makes it an attention-grabbing status symbol. Uses .44 caliber ammo.

items.name: CZ 52 Pistol
items.description: The CZ 52 military regulation pistol was the first pistol to use the roller-lock operating system. Known for its stability and reliability. Uses 7.62x25mm ammo.

items.name: F57 Pistol
items.description: The F57 pistol from FA Corp. People tend to remember it for its ergonomic design. It also features modular modification and powerful performance. Uses 5.7x28mm ammo.

items.name: MK3 Signal Gun
items.description: Produced by FA Corp, the MK3 Signal Gun is durable, reliable, and well-made. It can be equipped with a 26.5mm flare that deals a certain amount of burning damage when it hits its target.

items.name: M67 Frag Grenade
items.description: A grenade containing small, preformed fragments. Its steel shell splits into tiny shards on detonation. While it has a large damage radius, it only provides average armor piercing.

items.name: M18 Smoke Grenade
items.description: Creates a large cloud of smoke to conceal combatants or other targets.

items.name: Z3 Stun Grenade
items.description: A tactical weapon that uses light and noise to effectively incapacitate targets.

items.name: M84 Flashbang
items.description: The blast from this grenade generates an intense light over a large area, temporarily blinding anyone who hasn't guarded themselves against it.

items.name: Molotov Cocktail
items.description: A glass bottle filled with flammable liquid. Light and toss to create a pool of burning fuel.

items.name: GLI-F4 Tear Gas
items.description: This tear gas canister causes violent coughing when inhaled. Contact with the eyes causes burning and temporarily affects vision.

items.name: GHO 2 Offensive Grenade
items.description: An offensive grenade with no shrapnel. It contains a large amount of gunpowder. The concussion wave it produces can reach enemies even behind cover, causing them chronic tinnitus and slowing them down.

items.name: Mk 2 Frag Grenade
items.description: The shards on this grenade's shell are great for piercing armor.

items.name: M290 Stun Grenade
items.description: A specially designed tactical stun grenade that effectively incapacitates targets within range.

items.name: Downed Emergency Smoke Grenade
items.description: A quick-use smoke grenade that can be manually activated only when downed. This Downed Emergency Smoke Grenade is only distributed to combat squads operating in high-intensity warzones. Its specially designed fuse allows the wounded to deploy a smokescreen while downed, providing cover for the squad's movements.

items.name: PCC-9 Assault Rifle
items.description: A semi-automatic weapon that attempts to incorporate the characteristics of AR series rifles, it offers exceptional recoil control. It uses universal G-series pistol magazines loaded with 9mm pistol ammo.

items.name: ZC 807 Assault Rifle
items.description: FA Corp's CZ807 assault rifle. This weapon's modern modular design makes it a favorite among Ocean Alliance battalions.

items.name: AMB-17 Assault Rifle
items.description: The AMB-17 is the advanced, silenced model of Gorod's newest AM-17 assault rifle. Uses 9x39mm caliber ammo. It is frequently issued to Tevila's special forces.

items.name: AK-15SC Assault Rifle
items.description: The AK-15SC is the folding-barrel variant of the AK-15, Gorod's latest assault rifle. Uses 7.62×39mm caliber ammo. It is frequently issued to frontline troops for assault missions.

items.name: PP19-01 Submachine Gun
items.description: A Gorod submachine gun that serves as the modernized, improved version of the PP19.

items.name: ML Lever-Action Rifle
items.description: A classic .44 caliber cowboy weapon. Though its 19th century design is outdated, its extensive modernized upgrades and special loading mechanism has allowed it to maintain its own group of fans until this day.

items.name: RM44 Revolver
items.description: A large caliber revolver produced by an established small arms manufacturer. Stability and durability are the hallmarks of this weapon series, and it has multiple modernized, improved models. Uses .44 caliber ammo.

items.name: Improved Multi-Burst Flashbang
items.description: An improved flashbang modeled after the basic flashbang. Its stand-out feature is a high-intensity flash produced by multiple consecutive explosions, which completely blinds targets for a short period of time.

items.name: Experimental Shock Grenade
items.description: An experimental grenade that uses an impact fuse. It detonates upon impact with hard objects, instantly releasing a strong electrical current that paralyzes targets caught in its blast, preventing them from aiming down sights or sprinting.

items.description: A machine-made aluminum front grip. It can be mounted on a rail to provide enhanced chassis control while firing.

This upgrade replaces the trigger with a double-shot mechanism and adds a specially shaped trigger sear. A primary round is fired by pulling the trigger, and then another is fired upon releasing it; effectively firing two shots in one cycle.

items.name: Test Accessory: MPX Vulcan Barrel
items.description: An experimental accessory developed by Zeta Zone Tactical, this proof-of-concept barrel was designed for the MPX micro SMG. It features a critical spin barrel with polygonal rifling and a matching gas system, causing bullets to become unstable and tumble immediately upon impact. This increases damage and stopping power against unarmored targets, but reduces penetration and damage when impacting armor.

items.name: Test Accessory: FAL Burst Kit
items.description: An experimental accessory developed by Zeta Zone Tactical, this proof-of-concept kit was designed for the FAL assault rifle. It features a taper-bore barrel design, which continuously applies pressure to the bullet as the bore narrows during firing. This maintains chamber pressure while greatly improving firing power and armor penetration. However, because part of the chamber pressure is expended to overcome the bullet's deformation, the volume of gas entering the gas block is greatly reduced, slowing the bolt cycling speed and altering the recoil pattern.

items.description: The 6B bulletproof vest by Onotos Industrial has enough rigs for typical needs. It provides increased protection in the form of added plates. This, naturally, comes at the cost of extra weight.

items.name: TM1 Armored Rig
items.description: A bulletproof field vest made by Break Point Zero. The rig is well-suited for field operations due to its large capacity and ergonomic design.

items.name: TM2 Armored Rig
items.description: An upgraded bulletproof TM field armored chest rig with improved ergonomics and superior bulletproof material.

items.name: Sentry 305 Armored Chest Rig
items.description: A superior version of the Sentry 3, featuring increased protection and capacity. Only a very few elite units carry it.

items.name: H-Tac A8 Armored Rig
items.description: A premium tactical bulletproof vest made by Helka. Features excellent protection and high-capacity rigs. The first choice of Dark Zone operators.

items.name: H-Tac A9 Armored Rig
items.description: A premium tactical bulletproof vest made by Helka as an upgraded version of the A8. Provides an expanded protective area. Its only drawback is its price.

items.name: AVS Heavy Armored Rig
items.description: A premium tactical military chest rig made by FA Corp. Provides superior protection while remaining easy to use. An expensive piece of equipment used by pros.

items.name: M1955 Combat Vest
items.description: An old-style military service vest popular with jungle fighters. It served as inspiration for many fashion designers after its release. Even now, it is still able to provide some level of protection.

items.name: Defender M4 Heavy Armored Rig
items.description: The Gorod Defender M4 heavy armored chest rig. Features hardened steel and multiple magazine pouches. This rig is the first choice of the armies of the northern continent. This armored rig was worn by Renoir as he defended against the Second Clan's attack on the Marulos Armory during the North-South War.

items.name: H-Tac A10 Armored Rig
items.description: A Helka tactical vest with composite bulletproof lining. Includes mesh pockets, exterior webbing, and hooks, enabling the user to carry extra accessories.

items.name: SEK Heavy Armored Rig
items.description: Premium military tactical armored rig made by FA, often worn by special forces. Provides full protection. This heavy-duty bulletproof chest rig allows the user to pack gear for any conceivable combat scenario.

items.name: H-Tac 500 Armored Rig
items.description: This bulletproof vest from Helka Corp is part of the original H-TacA series. It performs very well for the cost, offering excellent protection and carrying capacity.

items.name: AR500 Composite Body Armor (For CG)
items.description: The instructor's armored chest rig in the tutorial.

items.name: AL Assault Armored Rig
items.description: In order to increase market popularity, Break Point Zero created this top-level assault armored rig, customized for special operations units. Using the mass-produced model as a basis, the company added an improved assault module carrying system, with no regard to cost, and mounted a variety of equipment adaptation kits. Kurt has confided to others that Rolf once suffered a crushing failure, ending up as the only mission survivor. Since then, Rolf has become more berserk and added heavy close-combat weapon mounts to his rig. At the same time, as a result of efforts to counter the symptoms of his severe PTSD, Rolf became addicted to pills.

items.name: AL Tactical Armored Rig
items.description: The Pioneer assault armored rig produced by Break Point Zero. To ensure sufficient defense capability, the designer has reserved slots on the front and back of the vest, which can be loaded with additional inserts as required. As a tactical model of the AL series, this rig adds more equipment interfacing onto the initial base model, in order to fully meet the user's needs. Through measured use of a variety of equipment, Bernard has done a lot for the squad and loves to use this rig. Afterward, his role gradually changed from sniper to comprehensive supporter.

items.name: AL Commander Armored Rig
items.description: The AL armored rigs are top-level armored rigs customized for special operations units by Break Point Zero, in order to increase market popularity. Among them, the AL Commander armored rig is the flagship model. It ranks among the best in the series for load capacity and protection power. Kurt was stationed in Espinos as Colom Overseas Commissioner, responsible for the recruitment and training of secret service personnel. After his squad was formed, Kurt applied for funds from above to equip the squad members with weapons and equipment. This top-level armor was on his list.

items.name: PM-G Type Heavy Armored Rig
items.description: Manufactured by Gorod, this PM-series heavy armored rig was originally specially produced for troops, but following several iterations, the G type was launched commercially. Offering comprehensive protection, the PM-G provides a large-capacity rig, which can meet various mounting needs. Porrero took advantage of the chaos caused by the fierce fighting between the northern and southern fronts in the Onotos region and seized control of the mines. However, the jail guards were defeated, which meant that the prisoners lost their biggest enemy, so Porrero was soon betrayed by his men and had to flee in shame. After escaping from the mines and faced with Doss' proposal, he took over this heavy armored rig and swore allegiance to the family. Now part of the family, he sometimes imagines a day where he could return to the mines and take back the position that belongs to him.

items.name: Canvas Backpack
items.description: Rugged and durable canvas backpack often used by loggers and truckers to transport their tools. Well-suited to scavenging.

items.name: Simple Backpack
items.description: A simple, lightweight commuter backpack with a double strap. Can easily hold a laptop and wallet.

items.name: Lightweight Camping Backpack
items.description: A lightweight civilian backpack for camping. Simple, practical, and affordable.

items.name: Medium Camping Backpack
items.description: A mid-size camping backpack. Very useful when going on hikes, but not so helpful when you need to move large equipment.

items.name: Outdoor Travel Backpack
items.description: A camping backpack made by Chapman Equipment. Ergonomically designed and made with composite materials, it is waterproof and heat-resistant, and can even be used to cross rivers in an emergency.

items.name: XA4 Tactical Backpack
items.description: A Break Point Zero XA series tactical military backpack. Its modular design provides plenty of space.

items.name: 926 Field Backpack
items.description: This backpack was originally intended for civilian use. The fabric and straps of this version have been optimized for field operations, making it a first-rate piece of military equipment.

items.name: Field Camping Backpack
items.description: A high-capacity camping backpack made by Chapman Equipment. Its hulking size is bound to raise a few eyebrows on the battlefield.

items.name: Sling Bag
items.description: A bag loved by postal workers and commuters alike. It's easy to pick things up while carrying it, though its capacity is somewhat limited.

items.name: LUC Expanded Tactical Backpack
items.description: Some argue that such a big backpack is a liability on the battlefield. They obviously haven't used one to bring their loot home.

items.name: Sports Backpack
items.description: A lightweight bag constructed from waterproof fabric, well-suited to all kinds of outdoor sports. Has plenty of room for your baseball glove and helmet.

items.name: Canvas Camping Backpack
items.description: A canvas backpack designed for hiking and camping. Features a separate compartment for tools. Not too heavy and fairly roomy.

items.name: Chapman Military Backpack
items.description: A multipurpose military backpack made by Chapman Equipment. Specifically designed for field units.

items.name: Med Field Backpack
items.description: A professional military backpack made by 926 Equipment. Originally intended for support units and medical personnel, it was later issued to combat units.

items.name: AMP7 Assault Backpack
items.description: A tactical assault backpack made by Chapman Equipment for elite units. Features large capacity, along with excellent ergonomics and flexibility.

items.name: RUSH Tactical Backpack
items.description: A tactical backpack made by Chapman Equipment. Features large capacity and compact structure.

items.name: RAL Heavy Military Backpack
items.description: A high-capacity military RAL backpack made by Break Point Zero. So large, it seems nearly bottomless.

items.name: Cowhide Backpack
items.description: A coarse and retro leather backpack. Might look a bit shabby, but it gets the job done.

items.name: Large Camping Backpack
items.description: A large camping backpack made by Chapman. Made using breathable materials, providing greater comfort during long term use. Its bright colors are meant to increase your chances of survival in emergencies, though they might have the opposite effect in the Dark Zone.

items.name: Retro Marching Backpack
items.description: A retro marching pack. Features basic fabrics and a practical design. Durable and capacious.

items.name: Com1 Tactical Headset
items.description: An ANC tactical headset made by International Firearms. Dampens explosive sounds while amplifying fainter noises. Suitable for CQB and covert operations.

items.name: M32 Tactical Headset
items.description: A tactical headset from Global United Communication Co., Ltd. Popular with SWAT officers.

items.name: Z038 Tactical Headset
items.description: A tactical headset made by International Firearms. Features an enhanced ergonomic design, making the headset much more comfortable. A more powerful microphone provides the headset with improved range.

items.name: GS2 Tactical Headset
items.description: An upgraded tactical headset made by Global United Communication Co., Ltd. Features enhanced low-frequency filtering for better sound location.

items.name: Commander A Tactical Headset
items.description: A premium tactical headset made by Universal Comms. The first choice of battlefield commanders and master tacticians.

items.name: Security Riot Helmet
items.description: A heavy and durable security helmet. Provides adequate protection against conventional opponents.

items.name: Aviator Helmet
items.description: A very cool safety helmet worn by chopper pilots. Comfortable and lightweight, but not great at stopping bullets.

items.name: PAS2 Helmet
items.description: A mass-produced Onotos military helmet. Widely used in the past. Provides new recruits with cost-effective protection.

items.name: F80 Tactical Helmet
items.description: A Helka tactical helmet. The optimized version of the F70 with a much lower impact on mobility.

items.name: 6BNT Helmet
items.description: Product of a bygone era. Provides all-round protection when combined with the 6B mask. It might even improve your welding skills.

items.name: HG84 Offensive Helmet
items.description: A heavy-duty military helmet made by Helka. Provides reliable protection for special forces. The simplified tactical interface guarantees combat functionality.

items.name: 6B4 Helmet
items.description: A premium military helmet, produced by Onotos in small quantities for elite units. Uses an updated design with more comprehensive protection. Worth owning.

items.name: DOD9 Blast Helmet
items.description: A Helka heavy blast helmet, normally used in settings where there is a high risk of explosions.

items.name: F70 Tactical Helmet
items.description: A basic tactical helmet produced by Helka using composite materials. Lighter and more durable than earlier models, with an integrated tactical rail that permits the attachment of additional features.

items.name: FA Assault Tactical Helmet
items.description: High-end protection from FA Corp, designed for special ops and assault operations. Clean and highly effective; two hallmarks of the FA brand.

items.name: IND50 Heavy Tactical Helmet
items.description: The latest offering in the IND series. Provides effective protection with comprehensive tactical interfaces and state of the art ergonomics. Usually issued to elite units.

items.name: IND Tactical Helmet
items.description: A tactical helmet from International Firearms made of advanced composite materials. Its ergonomic design provides comfort and convenience. Includes a universal tactical rail that can be fitted with various functional accessories.

items.name: SH18 Military Helmet
items.description: A classic Gorod military helmet made from titanium alloy. Lightweight and sleek, with a highly distinctive appearance. Sometimes referred to as a "watermelon."

items.name: AS200 Heavy Tactical Helmet
items.description: A top-of-the-line FA Corp heavy tactical helmet. Its simple design features a larger protective area than earlier variants, along with high-grade bulletproofing.

items.name: Security Helmet
items.description: A polymer helmet commonly used by security forces. Lightweight and strong, it provides adequate protection against common militants.

items.name: 6B5 Helmet
items.description: Upgraded version of the 6B4 helmet, made with advanced materials which greatly improve its performance.

items.name: PAS Standard Helmet
items.description: Simplified PAS military helmet made by Onotos. Mostly used by security forces.

items.name: KSS Tactical Helmet
items.description: A latest generation tactical military helmet from Helka. Rugged and cool-looking. Suitable for use in all kinds of environments. The only bad thing about it is its price. If you do happen to have the funds, consider buying in bulk.

items.name: Motorcycle Helmet
items.description: A cool motorcycle helmet. Its outer shell provides basic protection, but please don't expect it to stop direct fire from heavy weapons.

items.name: Tanker Protective Cap
items.description: A retro helmet used by armored vehicle crews, made from aramid with a specially hardened surface.

items.name: Retro Steel Helmet
items.description: An antique military helmet made from bulletproof steel. It may be a bit scruffy, but it is great value for money and has been known to stop bullets from time to time.

items.name: SH12 Military Helmet
items.description: A heavy-duty military helmet made by Gorod. Popular with frontline troops, but quite uncomfortable. Probably not suited for picky operators.

items.name: SH40 Military Helmet
items.description: A premium full-protection military helmet from Gorod. Takes your protection to the next level. Can be fitted with a mask to minimize splatter during mop-up operations.

items.name: KSS2 Tactical Helmet
items.description: An improved version of the KSS helmet. Its use of composite materials increases durability but reduces versatility. Suitable for heavy combat units.

items.name: IND200 Helmet
items.description: An upgraded version of the IND tactical helmet made by International Firearms. Features enhanced durability while maintaining all the advantages of the original model. Popular with professionals.

items.name: 03 Heavy Tactical Helmet
items.description: A heavy-duty tactical helmet, produced in limited quantities for the world's most elite soldiers.

items.name: RSP Heavy Tactical Helmet
items.description: A heavy-duty military helmet made by Gorod for export markets. Includes additional tactical features, but excludes headset compatibility to ensure protective functions are not compromised. Chunky and reliable.

items.name: SH50 Military Helmet
items.description: Gorod's most premium mass-produced military helmet. Provides first class protection and excellent value for money compared to imported models.

items.name: SH Matzka 2 Helmet
items.description: A special variant of the SH series. Shoving this bucket on your head may block out the world, but at least it'll block out the damage as well.

items.name: 6B4 Helmet (Squad Skin)
items.description: An Onotos 6B4 helmet issued in limited quantities to elite units. Features modern design paired with all-round protection. A set was awarded to Ajax in recognition of his heroics at the Armory. It was one of the main reasons he decided to follow Renoir.

items.name: Lightweight Safety Helmet
items.description: A lightweight safety helmet, commonly used by workmen and firefighters. Made of fluorescent plastic with reflective panels, it is bound to bring a bit of color to the battlefield.

items.name: SH65 Military Helmet
items.description: The latest version in the Gorod SH series helmets, made from ultra-high strength composite materials. Can be fitted with masks like the SH65 to further enhance protection.

items.name: SH60 Military Helmet
items.description: A top-of-the-line Gorod tactical helmet. Advanced composite materials provide the wearer with enhanced protection. Can also be used with the SH60 mask.

items.name: RST Special Forces Helmet
items.description: A Gorod RST heavy duty special forces helmet. Can be optionally equipped with the RST mask. Provides all-round protection at the cost of additional weight.

items.name: IND70 Tactical Helmet
items.description: An ultra-high spec ballistic helmet designed for frontline combat. Its polyethylene structure provides the optimal balance of weight and performance. Produced in very limited quantities and only made available to vanguard units.

items.name: AN95 Heavy Blast Helmet
items.description: An FA Corp heavy-duty special forces helmet, made from titanium alloy and rated as offering class V protection. Compatible with bulletproof glass masks, which serve to further improve its performance.

items.name: Kelsey Fire Helmet
items.description: A vintage firefighter's helmet only seen in old movies. Looks cool, but its ability to block bullets is basically non-existent.

items.name: 56K Helicopter Helmet
items.description: A 56K helicopter pilot helmet, made by International Firearms. Features additional lateral jaw protection. Popular with pilots for its macho vibe and excellent performance.

items.name: Old Black Helmet
items.description: A steel helmet used in decades past. Fashionable, affordable, and lightweight. It was popular with troops because it relieved pressure on the head and neck. It is still considered a bulletproof helmet, even by today's standards.

items.name: Retro Military Helmet
items.description: A combat helmet considered to be a collector's piece in some circles. It was an advanced design in its day, so it might still be able to block some bullets.

items.name: IND Tactical Helmet (Snow)
items.description: A tactical helmet produced by International Firearms, made of advanced composite materials. Its ergonomic design provides comfort and convenience. Includes a universal tactical rail that can be fitted with various functional accessories. Fred often sits lost in thought alone on the Northridge Hotel balcony, looking out across the Timor Sea, watching the sunset over snowcapped mountains. Tales of the Woodland Wraith once struck terror into the hearts of his enemies. When the sun sets behind the snowy mountains, he thinks of his past.

items.name: IND50 Heavy Tactical Helmet
items.description: (Pending game world content update)

items.name: YHR Helmet
items.description: The instructor's helmet in the tutorial.

items.name: 6B47 Helmet
items.description: The instructor's helmet in the tutorial.

items.name: RSE Heavy Blast Helmet
items.description: Gorod manufactured this full-coverage heavy blast helmet for high-intensity battlefields. It's made from a single piece of hardened steel to provide comprehensive protection to the wearer. After losing his shackles, Porrero struggled to adjust to being in a relaxed environment, until one day when he found this helmet in the mines equipment room. With its full coverage, it's pretty dark and cramped in there, which isn't ideal for doing things. But at that time, the shackle-like helmet gave Porrero a sense of security, and it wasn't long before it saved his life in the chaos that ensued in the mines.

items.name: DK6 Security Ballistic Mask
items.description: A universal bulletproof mask made by 926 Equipment, compatible with most security and military helmets that employ universal tactical adapters. Provides enhanced protection without additional encumbrance or affecting the wearer's vision.

items.name: DK5 Universal Bulletproof Mask
items.description: A universal bulletproof mask made by 926 Equipment, compatible with most security and military helmets that employ universal tactical adapters. Affordable and provides basic protection, greatly increasing survivability of Dark Zone operators.

items.name: Gorod Reinforced Mask
items.description: A reinforced mask made by Gorod.

items.name: L2F Shield
items.description: A LSHZ 2DTM bulletproof face shield. Combines composite materials and bulletproof glass for enhanced protection.

items.name: DK7 Premium Bulletproof Mask
items.description: A premium bulletproof mask made by 926 Equipment, designed for close combat operations. Blocks low caliber military rifle rounds. Typically used on heavy duty combat helmets. Not very versatile.

items.name: 6BNT Blast Mask
items.description: Onotos dedicated 6BNT face armor. Perfectly captures the aesthetic of an old school industrial-style welding mask. Provides unrivalled facial protection.

items.name: SH Matzka Mask
items.description: Gorod's upgraded version of the Matzka mask. Offers enhanced protection, although it obstructs the wearer's field of view to a certain extent. Preventing damage is its main priority.

items.name: SH60 Mask
items.description: A Gorod bulletproof mask made for the SH60 military helmet. Strong and durable. Provides excellent protection.

items.name: SH65 Military Mask A
items.description: A mask used on the SH65 military helmet. Thickened bulletproof glass provides the user with first-class protection and peace of mind.

items.name: SH Universal Bulletproof Mask
items.description: A Gorod SH universal ballistic mask, for use with most normal SH series helmet models.

items.name: SH65 Military Mask B
items.description: A mask designed to be used with the SH65 military helmet. Uses composite materials instead of glass for better protection at the cost of reduced field of view.

items.name: AN95 Military
items.description: A ballistic mask designed for the AN95 helmet. Made from high-grade bullet-proof glass, it provides effective protection against frontal and lateral fire.

items.name: RST Special Forces Mask
items.description: A mask that can be fitted on the RST heavy blast helmet. Made from a combination of fiberglass and aluminum to ensure protective capability.

items.name: DK8 Military Bulletproof Mask
items.description: A military-grade bulletproof mask produced by 926 Equipment by taking existing bulletproof mask designs and adding thickened frontal protection. It offers excellent defense and is sturdy and durable, but due to its special connection structure, it can only be used on some helmets.

items.name: 220 Body Armor
items.description: A mass-produced standard bulletproof vest. It is close-fitting and incorporates bulletproof materials on front and back. However, it does not protect the wearer from large caliber weapons or shots fired at close-range.

items.name: Retro Air Force Body Armor
items.description: Bulky vintage air force body armor in excellent condition. It incorporates steel bulletproof lining to form a large protective area. It was regarded as a very good bulletproof vest back in the day.

items.name: SEK Fortress Body Armor
items.description: A tactical military bulletproof vest made by FA Corp. Features a standardized design, with modular armor inserts and easily adjustable size, making it quick and simple to use.

items.name: H-LC Tactical Body Armor
items.description: A heavy duty tactical bulletproof vest made by Helka. Features new composite materials, alloy inserts, laser-cut straps, and panels. Comfortable and lightweight.

items.name: Marshal Heavy Body Armor
items.description: An FA Corp US Marshal series heavy body armor. Shares the same design as other FA products. Simple and sturdy, it provides effective protection to a large area of the body.

items.name: H-Tac SWAT Body Armor
items.description: A lightweight body armor made by Helka. Features a low visibility design, suitable for elite special operations units.

items.name: KN Regulation Body Armor
items.description: An early example of mass-produced military body armor from Gorod. While it is made of cheap materials and utilizes an outdated design, it still provides class III protection. It is simple, affordable, and suitable for a variety of uses.

items.name: H-LC Lightweight Body Armor
items.description: A lightweight military vest made by Helka which employs an ergonomic design that enables outstanding mobility and flexibility. Usually worn by scouts, assault squads, and other combat units.

items.name: BT6 Heavy Body Armor
items.description: A BT series heavy tactical vest, made with the latest fabrics and laser cutting technology. Protects the user from direct fire at close range.

items.name: BT101 Tactical Body Armor
items.description: An upgraded version of the BT series heavy tactical vest. Its ceramic pads provide enhanced protection. Available in different materials for different combat scenarios.

items.name: Standard SWAT Armor
items.description: A lightweight bulletproof vest favored by professionals in all fields. Close-fitting and unassuming, it can be worn underneath a shirt.

items.name: 6B23 Body Armor
items.description: Military body armor made by Onotos Production. While outdated, it provides very effective protection over a large area of the body, including the neck, at the cost of reduced flexibility.

items.name: IMTV Samurai Standard Body Armor
items.description: A Helka heavy body armor set, made with new materials which reduce weight while maintaining protective capability. The name speaks for itself.

items.name: IMTV Samurai Assault Body Armor
items.description: A Helka heavy body armor set. The Samurai series offensive configuration sacrifices lower body protection for greater flexibility, while also providing enhanced upper arm protection. Suitable for CQB combat.

items.name: IMTV Samurai Full Protection Body Armor
items.description: A Helka heavy body armor set, the Samurai series full body defensive configuration maximizes protected areas at the cost of reduced flexibility.

items.name: 926 Composite Body Armor
items.description: Military body armor made by 926 Equipment. Features bulletproof composite lining and is certified as providing class V protection. Armor plates are fixed with elastic straps to provide the user with all-round protection.

items.name: Spartan B Body Armor
items.description: Spartan series military body armor by 926 Equipment. Extensively tested in the field, this armor is known to be reliable. Its straps and shoulder pads use padded mesh for enhanced comfort and ventilation. This armor is known for its appearance as much as anything else.

items.name: Old Security Body Armor
items.description: A bulletproof vest worn by security guards, made from waterproof, windproof fabric that fits well over uniforms. The Kevlar lining serves to protect users during bank robberies and shootouts on the streets.

items.name: Defender M4 Heavy Body Armor
items.description: Defender series military body armor by Gorod. An upgraded version of the M4 series, featuring a higher level of protection and larger protective area. Often used by frontline units.

items.name: Retro Bulletproof Vest
items.description: Worn out, retro body armor. Still provides a degree of protection against shotguns and small caliber firearms; at least on a psychological level.

items.name: Defender M4 Heavy Body Armor (Officer Skin)
items.description: Gorod Defender M4 heavy body armor. Features an enhanced level of protection and a larger protective area. Renoir found a set in a secret underground cache after he seized control of the Armory. He then dispatched Ajax to take the Farm in Arbor.

items.name: Security Body Armor
items.description: A regulation bulletproof vest for elite units. Offers additional protection to vital parts without being too bulky.

items.name: 6B13 Body Armor
items.description: An improved version of 6B series military body armor made by Onotos Production. Incorporates multiple layers of armor over vital areas. The fabric used is also more durable.

items.name: KN Assault Body Armor
items.description: Mass-produced military body armor from KN. Provides more protection than the regulation model, although the additional weight does reduce the user's mobility.

items.name: KN Composite Body Armor
items.description: The latest generation of heavy body armor developed by Gorod for export. Incorporates composite fabrics and ceramic armor plates that reduce weight and increase the level of protection. So expensive, only the rich can afford it.

items.name: 6B45 Heavy Body Armor
items.description: The heaviest type of mass-produced 6B body armor from Onotos Industrial. Its design takes inspiration from many types of heavy body armor. Made from ballistic steel. A bit on the heavy side, but makes the wearer feel like a tank.

items.name: PCA350 Body Armor
items.description: A tactical armored vest from International Firearms, features armor plating on the front and back, a quick release mechanism and easy-to-use rail buckle, making it the perfect choice for getting a head start on your enemy.

items.name: IND401 Body Armor
items.description: Tactical body armor from International Firearms, part of the IND tactical series. Provides users with all-round protection.

items.name: Retro Sapper Bulletproof Chest Armor
items.description: Vintage bulletproof armor made from forged steel plate. It was originally designed to protect sappers as they swept for mines. Later, it was found to perform well in urban theaters.

items.name: Retro Infantry Bulletproof Vest
items.description: An old bulletproof vest used by infantry. The jacket and aluminum bulletproof layer are still intact, but don't expect it to stop any bullets.

items.name: BT201 Full Body Armor
items.description: International Firearms BT201 full body armor, designed for extreme battlefield environments. An advanced aluminum alloy covers most of the torso. Only a few were ever made owing to the high cost and weight.

items.name: 926 Composite Gen 2 Body Armor
items.description: An upgraded version of the 926 composite bulletproof vest. Uses patented semi-rigid plastic in the bulletproof lining, reducing weight while increasing flexibility and mobility. The jewel in the 926's crown.

items.name: Ranger Body Armor
items.description: A ceramic bulletproof vest with camouflage, suited to jungle warfare. Often used by Rangers, it has a nylon belt for the attachment of various tools.

items.name: Variable Body Armor
items.description: Body armor featuring two composite ceramic bulletproof panels that can be attached independently using external rigging, although it is recommended they be used as part of the vest.

items.name: Lwt. Body Armor
items.description: Ultra-light aramid fiber bulletproof body armor, used primarily by vehicle crews. Provides limited protection over a relatively small area.

items.name: T7 Thermal Imager
items.description: A thermal imager. Can be mounted on a multipurpose tactical rail, providing the user with a wide field of view in the infrared spectrum. Bad news for anyone hiding in the bushes.

items.name: RAL Full Gas Mask
items.description: A Break Point Zero mask, made from strong bromobutyl rubber. Features an excellent seal and a wide field of view, ensuring the safety and vision of the wearer.

items.name: RAL10 Universal Gas Mask
items.description: A Break Point Zero RAL10 universal gas mask, produced in large quantities to ensure success of operations in challenging environments. Also able to defend against tear gas attacks.

items.name: SH-3 Gas Mask
items.description: A universal gas mask made by Gorod, designed with the convenience of left-handed soldiers in mind. Features detachable lateral ports and an adapter that facilitates the installation of different filters.

items.name: SH-4 Gas Mask
items.description: A new compact combination full face mask from Gorod Industrial, featuring larger goggles and reinforced seam for a tighter seal and better protection.

items.name: RAL40 Premium Gas Mask
items.description: A popular dual-cartridge gas mask by Break Point Zero. It is made from chlorinated butyl rubber components and silicone compounds to prevent infiltration and corrosion. The high degree of flexibility and comfort permits extended usage of the product.

items.name: RAL20 Field Gas Mask
items.description: This gas mask is the first choice of all units in the field. It features lenses made from polycarbonate materials that provide protection against UV rays and glare. Manufactured by Break Point Zero and fitted with a new type of filter cartridge.

items.name: RAL Goggle Gas Mask
items.description: A next-generation gas mask from Break Point Zero. The main body is made of a proprietary butyl blend material, and the large eyepiece provides soldiers with a wider field of vision.

items.name: SW-5 Half Gas Mask
items.description: Premium half-gas mask produced by 926 Equipment. Boasts outstanding ergonomic design, and the filter element adopts the latest technology to ensure powerful gas protection while also reducing weight.

items.name: Fast-acting Painkiller
items.description: A few pain relief pills. Cheap, pocketable, fast-acting, and easy to use.

items.name: EX Painkiller
items.description: A bottle of extra-strength aspirin. Reduces pain and inflammation. Can also reduce fever and cold symptoms.

items.name: AP Painkiller
items.description: A bottle of painkillers. Provides strong pain relief. For use in emergencies.

items.name: Anti-Inflam Painkiller
items.description: A small red pill for reducing inflammation and pain. Cheap and not particularly potent, but suitable for temporary relief.

items.name: Liquid Painkiller
items.description: A concentrated painkiller injection. Effective and fast-acting, it will get your injured troops back on their feet in no time.

items.name: Energy Drink
items.description: A fast-acting oral stimulant, rich in vitamins.

items.name: Quick Bandage
items.description: A common bandage. Good enough for most small cuts, but not large enough to treat major wounds.

items.name: Field Bandage

items.name: Insecticide

items.description: A regular watch made by local artisanal watchmakers. Casual and cost effective, can be a souvenir.

items.name: Metal Horse Comb
items.description: A metal comb specially designed for the grooming of equine manes. Often seen at farms and stables.

items.name: Bag of Fertilizer
items.description: Imported fertilizer with a high performance-to-cost ratio. Popular among local farmers.

items.name: Camping Tarp
items.description: A camping tarp that effectively shields against the rain.

items.name: Film Stock
items.description: Imported movie film stock that is no longer usable today.

items.name: Handheld Fill Light
items.description: A handheld light used to provide more illumination in environments where light is lacking.

items.name: Bag of Seeds
items.description: A bag of full of crop seeds. The seeds inside are sealed in a plastic bag.

items.name: Camping Stove
items.description: A portable stove that can provide a modest flame out of doors. A must-have item for campers.

items.name: Camping Lantern
items.description: A waterproof lantern that serves as a reliable light source for campers at night.

items.name: Kamona Bird Plush
items.description: The kamona is the state bird of the country of Kamona and is beloved by the locals of the region. A kamona plush toy produced by a local toy factory was so popular, it even sold out at one point in time.

items.name: Doss Rose Box
items.description: A pot of roses printed with the Doss Flowers logo. The flowers are in full bloom. Some days ago, Noah, who went with the submarine to the Valley, picked some flowers from the Antonio family's flower field and brought them back to the Port. Even though he was about to leave this place of chaos, Noah still planned on giving them as a gift to a friend.

items.name: Mug
items.description: A dusty white porcelain mug. It probably needs a wash before it can be used.

items.name: Metal Spoon
items.description: A slightly bent metal spoon. The tip is covered in scratches, as though someone once used it as a shovel.

items.name: Deluxe Tea Set
items.description: An exquisite set that's best reserved for imported teas such as black tea. To a certain extent, their interest in tea serves as a contrast to the lifestyle of the locals.

items.name: Lute
items.description: A well-preserved traditional plucked string instrument. It brings joy and comfort to life, even in times of hardship and war.

items.description: Infusion bags stocked by local hospitals; used to maintain patients' fluids.

items.name: NaCl

items.name: Drug Nebulizer
items.description: Liquid medicine pulverized into tiny particles that can enter the respiratory tract through inhalation for treatment purposes.

items.name: Medical Sponge
items.description: A medical consumable commonly used in surgery. It acts as a filler to quickly treat wounds.

items.name: Medical Scissors
items.description: A pair of surgical scissors.

items.description: Unknown biological matter from a clinic; very popular on the Market.

items.name: Disinfectant
