items.description: A portable medical device that can be used by non-professionals to save patients who are in cardiac arrest.

items.name: Insulin Pump
items.description: A high-end medical instrument consisting of a pump, a small syringe, and a cannula. Automatically injects micro volumes of insulin over time into the user to mimic the body's production of insulin.

items.name: Simple Thermometer
items.description: A traditional thermometer. Uses the principle of thermal expansion to test for changes in a person's temperature. Easy, simple, and reliable.

items.name: Cotton Balls
items.description: A bag of cotton balls for medical use. A survival item that's extremely popular among militants.

items.name: Metal Heart
items.description: At its most basic level, a metal heart is really just an extremely durable mini-pump capable of replacing an organic heart. There might not be much demand for heart transplants in the Dark Zone, but people always need a sturdy little pump... even if it is a bit of wasted potential.

items.name: Gold Cheetah Statue
items.description: A golden cheetah running. Or maybe it's a leopard?

items.name: Commemorative Coin
items.description: Valuable commemorative coins. It might be a fake.

items.name: Vase
items.description: A vase that looks very expensive. It records the life of a nobleman.

items.name: Gold Watch
items.description: An expensive gold watch. The hour hand seems to be faulty.

items.name: Gold Lion Statue
items.description: A valuable golden lion statue.

items.name: Desk Clock
items.description: A table clock with extremely exquisite craftsmanship.

items.name: Antique Teapot
items.description: A rare antique ceramic teapot.

items.name: Silver Badge
items.description: A silver badge with special meaning.

items.name: Silver Chain
items.description: A rough silver bracelet.

items.name: Gold Bracelet
items.description: A crudely-made gold bracelet.

items.name: Porcelain
items.description: Fragile porcelain. Its value lies in the patterns adorning its surface.

items.name: Gold-rimmed Glasses
items.description: Gold-rimmed glasses that reflect the wearer's worth.

items.name: Stamp Album
items.description: A special collection booklet for safe preservation of stamps.

items.name: Record Player
items.description: Electrical equipment for playing records.

items.name: Pocket Watch
items.description: An intricately-crafted chain pocket watch with a beautifully-decorated caseback.

items.name: Stamp
items.description: A voucher for sending mail. It's also a collectible.

items.name: Spur
items.description: Marsden's son always dreamed about being a cowboy so, for his 12th birthday, Marsden got a blacksmith in the next town to make him a set of spurs. On the day of his son's birthday, Marsden got up early and headed to the blacksmith's. But then, he suddenly heard gunfire as he was returning to the Farm.

items.name: Decorative Gold Chain
items.description: An obnoxious chain made of Onotos gold; local artisans make it to reflect the owner's wealth and ability.

items.name: Gold Block
items.description: Local goldsmiths process this Onotos gold; local rich people see it as a way to preserve their wealth so they stock up on it and store it at home.

items.name: Diamond Ring
items.description: Expensive diamond ring set with a large diamond.

items.name: Brooch
items.description: Brooch made by local jewelers. It is expensive but beautiful and very popular in local stores.

items.name: Secret Document
items.description: The most mysterious file in the Dark Zone. It is rumored to contain the truth about a certain event and every faction in the Dark Zone would pay to get their hands on it.

items.name: Gold Cube
items.description: Kamona's most famous goldsmith randomly created this cube while forging gold jewelry. Both goldsmith and cube disappeared from the island. Generations later, local goldsmiths began re-creating this cube in his memory, making this golden cube a popular collector's item in the area.

items.name: Gem Necklace
items.description: Master goldsmiths set choice gemstones on just the right Onotos gold to create this dazzling necklace.

items.name: Gold Cup
items.description: This handmade artisanal gold cup was sold for a shocking price at auction; from this point, people began to see the collectible value of Kamona goldware.

items.name: Vintage Typewriter
items.description: A typewriter from Colom that many large companies purchased in bulk due to its reasonable price and durability. Some local merchants came together to bring in a shipment of these typewriters and later sold them to local companies.

items.name: Decorative Cane
items.description: A decorative cane made by a local craftsman. Its exquisite form and quality materials make it a potential collectible.

items.name: Plaster Sculpture
items.description: A practice piece with no name. Passable, but the student clearly put their heart into their work.

items.name: Majestic Sculpture
items.description: A forged sculpture made of plaster and gold. The exquisite details show that its maker was a master of their craft. According to the locals, the sculpture was once used as a decoration in a Marulos party and was the brightest star of the night.

items.name: Utopia Hazmat Case
items.description: A case of mysterious experimental reagents containing a partially erased Toland Group marker and several experiment reports. No one knows anything about the case's contents; except that these items would fetch a high price on the black market.

items.name: Gold Snake
items.description: A golden serpent coiled tightly around some ore. Grab the wealth that falls into your lap and never let it go!

items.name: Handmade Hunting Knife
items.description: Before the war, this exquisitely handmade hunting knife was often carried around as a symbol of courage and wealth. Yet now, the hunting knife here may be proof that a luxurious personal weapon is useless in the face of a collective crisis.

items.name: Skyhook Synchronized Array Mirror
items.description: The secondary reflector of the Skyhook Guidance System by Ring of Nibelungen. It entered the black market due to manufacturing defects. This collection of defective products allowed the public to gain a glimpse into Project Gungnir, yet at the same time, scholars of related fields started to express more doubts about the project.

items.name: Sergey 1 Satellite Model
items.description: A model of the world's first satellite launched by Tevila. Even though the Sergey 1 only remained in orbit for 20 days, it was enough to be labeled a key step in scientific research and a monumental moment in human history.

items.name: Raw Diamond Ore
items.description: Most would find this unremarkable stone easy to overlook without a certificate from a geologist, not even if it was displayed in a high-quality display cabinet. Though there is never a shortage of collectors willing to pay a high price for raw ores like this.

items.name: Jade Bracelet
items.description: A jade bracelet made of vibrant, dense, and flawless beads with a superior texture.

items.name: Gold Pen
items.description: A gilded, standard fountain pen with a faint Oligarch ID etched into its cap. It's likely to have been distributed by an oligarch department, though the reason they have appeared in the Dark Zone remains a mystery to be uncovered.

items.name: Classified Stimulant "Elysium"
items.description: A mysterious stimulant that leaked shortly after the Bay Area zombie outbreak. Preliminary analysis suggests it is an artificially engineered viral solution. Its composition closely resembles that of the previously leaked "Utopia," but at a much higher concentration.

items.name: Document
items.description: What looks to be an obsolete file.

items.name: Hardcover
items.description: Hardcover notebooks from local stationery factories; a hit with wealthy local kids.

items.name: Notebook
items.description: A notebook with indiscernible handwriting.

items.name: Folder
items.description: Strange writings and graphs in an unmarked folder. It's in English, but you barely understand any of it. The word "Gungnir" appears multiple times. First found in the farm.

items.name: Desk Calendar
items.description: A paper calendar on which each day has a different meaning.

items.name: Comic
items.description: An easy-to-carry picture book.

items.name: DZ Intel.
items.description: Note recording battles in the Dark Zone.

items.name: Manifest
items.description: A diary that records the daily life of a villa delivery man. The contents look unremarkable, and it's unknown why the delivery man was carrying it on his person. A limited-time item from an event. Can be exchanged for a reward.

items.name: Workman's Diary
items.description: A workman's diary with the logo of Kamona Petroleum. The author is a man named Desmond. The first half records the events of the conflict in Guoyapos. The words within might be silent, but you can almost hear the gunfire and the weeping echoing off the page. The latter half of the book is just as heart-wrenching, but the content becomes touching and sentimental. The diary ends with the following sentence: "What is the world outside Kamona like? I'd like to take a look." Not long ago, the author went to the Department Store to get a gift for his friend's kid and never returned to Twilight Apartment.

items.name: Sticky Notes
items.description: A pile of sticky notes. Stuck together with a weak non-drying adhesive, they are easy to peel off.

items.name: Old Book
items.description: An old book. Its cover shows the passage of time but you can still make out its title. The densely packed annotations and dog-eared pages inside may never see the light of day again.

items.name: Gungnir Blueprint Fragments
items.description: A collection of torn-apart Gungnir blueprint fragments. The contents seem to include sections of an enormous rail, whose design is consistent with the international standard launcher and has not been adapted for any specific country or region.

items.name: Gas Analyzer
items.description: An analyzer used by scientists to analyze the components of gas.

items.name: Air Tightness Tester
items.description: Locally produced air-tightness test tools. Affordable, simple and a favorite with engineers.

items.name: Pressure Gauge
items.description: A device used to measure pressure. However, it cannot measure mental pressure.

items.name: Multimeter
items.description: You can't tell it's a counter or a universal meter.

items.name: Wave Filter
items.description: A special power filter used in armored vehicles.

items.name: Oscilloscope
items.description: An instrument that assists users in observing electrical signals.

items.name: Rectifier
items.description: A device that converts alternating currents to direct currents. It can also charge batteries.

items.name: Antenna
items.description: An ordinary antenna for civilian use. Only a few local families have use for it, though.

items.name: Gimbal
items.description: A balancing apparatus for cameras that stabilizes the frame when in use.

items.name: Light Meter
items.description: An instrument that measures light intensity and, when conditions are met, is capable of calculating the aperture value for optimal exposure.

items.name: Weapon Parts
items.description: Parts disassembled from weapons. They can be recycled.

items.name: Cannon Shell
items.description: High-explosive shell fragment.

items.name: Paracord
items.description: Parachute cord. It is extremely strong and durable.

items.name: Safety Cord
items.description: The safety rope is the lifeline in the abseiling movement.

items.name: Military Canteen
items.description: An aluminum military-issue water bottle. Makes it easy to carry clean water.

items.name: Filter Canister
items.description: The filter device of a gas mask. It's still usable.

items.name: Military Compass
items.description: A military compass used to indicate directions.

items.name: Rangefinder Binoculars
items.description: A telescope with a laser ranging feature.

items.name: Portable Transceiver
items.description: A handheld, wireless walkie-talkie with an extra-short wavelength.

items.name: Military Radio
items.description: Old radio stations may still be able to intercept useful information.

items.name: Receiver
items.description: A signal receiver.

items.name: Signal Jammer
items.description: An assembled signal jamming device.

items.name: TI Module
items.description: Components of a thermal imaging system.

items.name: Radio
items.description: A station that can transmit and receive radio signals; usually found in local signal stations.

items.name: Leveler
items.description: A tool used to test leveling; handle with care to ensure accurate results.

items.name: Bosun's Whistle
items.description: A whistle used in the navy by the bosun to convey various orders on a warship. Today, it is used by naval patrol captains to call the patrol to the battlefield.

items.name: Target Positioning Module
items.description: One of the components of the military laser rangefinder. This is the module for target positioning.

items.name: Laser Pointer Module
items.description: One of the components of the military laser rangefinder. This is the laser pointer module.

items.name: Artillery Periscope Binoculars
items.description: These periscope binoculars can be used to observe the enemy target and measure the distance and angle without the user revealing their position.

items.name: Signals Set
items.description: A signals set used by intelligence that is capable of receiving transmissions on special frequency bands. Can be sold to merchants for a considerable return.

items.name: Battleforged Badge
items.description: A worn, scratched badge. In Renoir's eyes, it has long ceased to symbolize honor.

items.name: Pocket Knife
items.description: A well-crafted saber. For Ajax, it represents that he has the approval of powerful people.

items.name: Fred's Wedding Ring
items.description: A gold ring that Fred keeps close. While the weight of the ring can be felt, the person it represents will never return. He lost the original ring in the Siege of Onotos then later, captured the Onotos gold mine and ordered a famous local goldsmith to use the gold there and recreate it based on Fred's memory.

items.name: Handmade Gold
items.description: An ancient gold coin engraved with patterns. It's covered in signs of wear. Doss holds it every day, feeling the authority and power he was taken with his own hands. Doss returned to the Valley with the help of his partners and resumed the family business of dealing weapons and drugs. He simultaneously uses his various identities to establish profitable links with various Dark Zone factions.

items.name: Compass
items.description: A high-performance compass used by special forces to quickly determine distances and azimuth angles. This particular compass was a parting gift from Kurt's former captain, and Kurt has used this compass to lead his team out of danger in the complex battlefield that is the desert.

items.name: Brass Knuckles
items.description: A set of rather heavy brass knuckles. While it has seen years of use, it has obviously been well cared for by its owner. Although Rolf, ever the combat enthusiast, has since moved on to handier weapons, he still carries this reminder of the past.

items.name: Airborne Badge
items.description: A regulation badge for members of Colom's special air service task force. It bears the image of a parachute. Each and every owner of this badge is undoubtedly an elite. Bernard has continued to carry this reminder of his past glory after his retirement.

items.name: Cut-Off Streamer
items.description: A section of streamer cut off from a military cap. The emblem of the Northern Front Navy can still be vaguely seen on its edge. Once upon a time, Derwin was extremely proud of the fact that he was in the navy, and it was for this reason that he fought in Guoyapos for such a long time. However, after the commander of the Second Clan left the Northern Front, Captain Karl decided to sink the ship Polaris, then under repair, and return to the north with everyone and the deputy commander. Derwin defied the order to sink the Polaris, and subsequently took over control of the ship and the Port along with his followers, thus becoming a force to be reckoned with in the eastern waters of the Dark Zone.

items.name: Wooden Top
items.description: A roughly made wooden top with a name indistinctly carved into the side, many members of the Mad Dogs wonder why their hard-as-nails boss bothers to carry it around.

items.name: Immaculate Carabiner
items.description: As the climbing expert of her team, Hecate always has a simple climbing tool on her person. Also, it doesn't have any marks on it, Hecate is constantly polishing this tool. This is because Hecate knows that in a moment of crisis, this tool will have to save more just than herself.

items.name: Hand-Drawn Map
items.description: A map Randy drew by hand while traveling Kamona. The map has location markings and military symbols, and the reverse side contains information about the local flora.

items.name: Prototype Mini-Drone
items.description: Maxim's attempt at a homemade drone after testing a recon model. The design goal was to compress its size and noise to the absolute limit. Of course, whether he actually succeeded is another matter entirely.

items.name: Game Console
items.description: It is broken. It was the star product of the holidays.

items.name: DVD
items.description: It is the latest music player, provided that you can afford the corresponding disc.

items.name: Security Camera
items.description: Surveillance camera.

items.name: Fuse
items.description: Civilian electric fuses are often used for safety in electrical circuits.

items.name: Card Reader
items.description: A device used to identify RFID cards. It is quite hard to come by.

items.name: BP Machine
items.description: A blue BP machine, the receiver of the called user in the wireless paging system.

items.name: Classic Radio
items.description: A radio with poor sound quality.

items.name: Lens
items.description: A lens used in video capture devices and security systems. It's very fragile, so please handle with care.

items.name: Camera
items.description: A heavy optical device. Its flash is useful for nighttime photography.

items.name: Cassette Walkman
items.description: Portable audio equipment that can hold cassettes.

items.name: Broken Phone
items.description: It is crushed beyond repair.

items.name: Gold Phone
items.description: A golden phone that looks very expensive.

items.name: Mobile Phone
items.description: A cheap-looking phone.

items.name: Data Cable
items.description: An ordinary data cable that can be used to transfer data between computers.

items.name: Video Camera
items.description: An imported video camera designed for civilian use. While it looks a little old, it works perfectly fine.

items.name: Shutter Cable
items.description: An ordinary-looking camera shutter cable that allows the user to release the camera shutter remotely.

items.name: Laptop Computer
items.description: A new kind of computer that has exploded in popularity overseas. While it is highly portable, it also commands a rather hefty price tag. Only a few wealthy families are likely to buy it.

items.name: Experimental Ultra-Strength Treatment
items.description: Use it to immediately heal limb injuries and other debuffs. You'll also obtain enhanced regeneration and faster HP recovery.

items.name: Experimental Physique Enhancing Pill
items.description: Use it to significantly enhance your physique. It increases the HP limit of the abdomen and all four limbs.

items.name: Y4O Experimental Ultra-Strength Treatment
items.description: Elisir Medicina once developed an experimental ultra-strength treatment, codenamed "Y3O." Although it could rapidly repair human tissue, it also caused severe side effects, and the company ultimately abandoned the project. Years later, a treatment named "Y4O" quietly appeared on the black market, and it had even stronger effects.

items.name: Experimental Physique Enhancing Pill (Improved)
items.description: Use it to significantly enhance your physique. It increases the HP limit of the abdomen and all four limbs. This is an improved version obtained through research at the Workbench, featuring an extended duration.

items.name: Experimental Ultra-Strength Treatment (Improved)
items.description: Use it to immediately heal limb injuries and other debuffs. You'll also obtain enhanced regeneration and faster HP recovery. This is an improved version obtained through research at the Workbench, featuring an extended duration.

items.name: Y4O Experimental Ultra-Strength Treatment (Improved)
items.description: Elisir Medicina once developed an experimental ultra-strength treatment, codenamed "Y3O." Although it could rapidly repair human tissue, it also caused severe side effects, and the company ultimately abandoned the project. Years later, a treatment named "Y4O" quietly appeared on the black market, and it had even stronger effects. This is an improved version obtained through research at the Workbench, which weakens the side effect of reducing maximum HP in each body part.

items.name: Portable Fuel Canister
items.description: A portable fuel canister developed by Chapman's outdoor department. It's said to be made of safer and more durable materials than other canisters on the market.

items.name: Magnesium Flint
items.description: A dark metal rod with a black striker. Scraping the magnesium rod produces high-temperature sparks, making it a reliable fire-starting tool for the wilderness; especially useful in wet conditions.

items.name: Arched Corrugated Steel Plate
items.description: A cut of arched corrugated steel plate, displayed in stores. It's covered in a rust-proof layer, and a numbered tag is affixed to the corner. In Kamona, samples of building materials like this are often harder to come by than the finished products.

items.name: Corrupted Steel Pipe
items.description: A steel pipe warped by an unknown reaction.

items.name: Corrupted Brass Tube
items.description: A brass tube warped by an unknown reaction.

items.name: Corrupted Glass
items.description: Plexiglass warped by an unknown reaction.

items.name: Solar Charger
items.description: A portable solar charger developed by Chapman. Capable of storing, charging, and supplying power alongside being waterproof for outdoor use.

items.name: Ni-Cd Battery Pack
items.description: A rechargeable Ni-Cd battery pack. Compared to regular rechargeable batteries, it offers excellent high-current discharge performance and better resistance to overcharging or over-discharging.

items.name: Capacitance Analyzer
items.description: A handheld capacitance analyzer featuring a small LCD screen on the front. Commonly used to measure capacitor values and detect electrical leakage in circuits.

items.name: Battery
items.description: Special battery packs. They are expensive and reliable.

items.name: High-Frequency Coil
items.description: A high-frequency coil is a type of distributed-parameter, series-resonant transformer capable of handling over one million volts. Among hobbyists, this device is known as an "artificial lightning spitter."

items.name: Space Lab Toybox
items.description: The "Space Lab" was a complex toy meant to help educate children about space. Produced by a toy manufacturer in Colom, it was delicately crafted; and extremely expensive. Less than a year after Space Lab was released, consumers discovered the toy came packaged with a small bottle of caustic, highly poisonous rocket propellant, after which it was quickly pulled from shelves by the Toy Association.

items.name: Skateboard
items.description: A commemorative skateboard manufactured by Colom's Radical Boards, Inc. It was made to resemble a board used in a classic sci-fi movie.

items.name: Quantum 2000 Toy Robot
items.description: A toy robot designed by a well-known toy manufacturer in Colom. It can be programmed using a built-in cassette tape, and its actions recorded with a remote control. The robot also functions as a simple cassette player. Due to its high price, it was discontinued after a limited production run. Years later, its rarity has made it a valuable collector's item.

items.name: Voice of Civilization Gold Record
items.description: To commemorate humanity's systematic exploration of outer space, Colom's aerospace department commissioned the creation of a gold record, "The Voice of Civilization." Its surface is etched with images of code and other special symbols that represent human civilization. The original record has flown through space on a detector. To memorialize this expedition, a few golden records were created using the exact same process. An aerospace engineer born in Kamona brought one of these back to their homeland, etching the words "Song of Kamona" onto the back of the record as a tribute to their home.

items.name: Northern Stars Amber Drink
items.description: Northern Stars is an aged, fruit-infused fermented beverage crafted by a long-established Tevilan distillery. Rumor has it that its recipe contains rare local wild berries and distilled alpine spring water, and that it was once reserved only for the high-ranking officials of the Northern Military Region. Each bottle is packed in an exquisite handmade walnut mechanical box. Later, the original distillery was shut down during the war, and both the recipe for Northern Stars and the box's unique craftsmanship were lost forever.

items.name: Toland Access Card
items.description: An access card issued to R&D personnel in Toland's Zombie Division. This card grants laboratory staff clearance, allowing the holder to access key areas throughout the facility.

items.name: Handheld Tester
items.description: A handheld medical tester. Precisely extracts a sample and provides the requested results.

items.name: EEG
items.description: The EEG is an advanced medical device developed by Toland Group's first medical department. It collects data on and monitors brain waves, providing essential, technological data to support medical diagnoses and scientific research. However, rumors have always circulated on the black market that the first medical department conducted illegal experiments on the brains of refugees to perfect this device.

items.name: Blood Glucose Meter Set
items.description: A blood glucose meter set from Elisir Medicina. The box contains a portable glucose meter, a lancet, and insulin.

items.name: Electronic Stethoscope
items.description: An electronic stethoscope sold by a subsidiary of Elisir Medicina.

items.name: Cloudy Sample
items.description: A cloudy sample containing collected materials. After successfully bringing it out, you can unlock Research Points through Zombie Research to operate more efficiently in the Infected Zone.

items.name: Active Sample
items.description: A securely sealed active sample. After successfully bringing it out, you can unlock Research Points through Zombie Research to operate more efficiently in the Infected Zone.

items.name: Purified Sample
items.description: A high-purity sample that has undergone purification. After successfully bringing it out, you can unlock Research Points through Zombie Research to operate more efficiently in the Infected Zone.

items.name: Infrared Therapy Lamp
items.description: An infrared therapy lamp manufactured by Elisir Medicina. The green metal lampshade is mounted on an adjustable support rod. Once turned on, it heats the filament, emitting a dark red light and thermal radiation. Formerly a standard fixture in Colom clinics and rehabilitation rooms, it has become a scarce commodity in the Dark Zone, valued for both its warmth and relief from lingering injuries.

items.name: Mutant Heart Sample
items.description: A mutant heart sample sealed inside a biomass constant-temperature storage container. This valuable mutant sample was acquired by a Sumek Committee zombie rapid response team during a large-scale extermination mission. The sample's structure is well-preserved and highly mutated, making it of immense research value.

items.name: Pheromone Test Kit
items.description: Rumor has it that shortly after the zombie disaster broke out, Toland rapidly developed a Pheromone Test Kit in secret. By injecting different pheromones, users can influence the behavioral tendencies of mutants within range and also evade mutant attacks for a certain period. It is said that this kit was only issued in small quantities to supervisory personnel and frontline special forces squads.

items.name: Blocker Injector
items.description: Following the zombie disaster, Toland provided the Committee with a batch of blockers and specialized Blocker Injectors. During the early stages of a mutant virus infection, administering the blocker can stop the virus from spreading and even render it inactive over time.

items.name: Mutated Tissue Mass
items.description: A mass of mutated tissue shed from a mutant. The cross-section still retains distinct muscle fibers, while the surface exhibits the distinctive mutant crystallization and tarring characteristics.

items.name: Zombie Sample
items.description: Zombie samples that were scattered across Kamona following the zombie outbreak.

items.name: Gilded Cage Music Box
items.description: One of Colom's most venerated watchmakers produced this limited-edition music box to commemorate 100 years in business. Delicately crafted in the form of a gilded cage, this stunning piece was sold out before it even hit the shelves.

items.name: Phaethon's Clock
items.description: The specter of Sumek still haunts the hearts of some people. Fearing the day they dread so much may come, these fearful folks created this special clock in the name of Phaethon, son of the sun god.

items.name: "Dawn"
items.description: An oil painting created by one of Tevila's most famous artists after the Sumek comet was discovered.

items.name: T-008 Robotic Arm
items.description: The arm of a robot from a beloved sci-fi blockbuster, fashioned from titanium alloy as a collector's piece by cinema superfans.

items.name: Real Matrix
items.description: "Face the truth or indulge in a fabrication?" To commemorate the classic science-fiction film, the renowned Colom jewelry company has released a limited-edition gemstone collectible.

items.name: Ancient Golden Mask Replica
items.description: Based on the golden mask of the most famous ruler in the history of the desert, this exquisite 1:1 replica was copied from the museum original. With the enormous amount of gold and gemstones used in its creation and the fact that it was handcrafted by contemporary masters, this modern replica is extremely valuable to collectors.

items.name: Airplane Model Toy
items.description: Welcome to the Exhibition Treasure Hunt! Collect model airplanes and deliver them to the central booth. Collect all the model airplanes to activate the lucky slot machine. Once the condition is met, each member of the team can use the lucky slot machine once to receive their own exclusive prize.

items.name: Hefra Egg
items.description: The Hefra Egg, also known as the Tevila Egg, is a precious collectible from a series created by the famous Tevilan jeweler, Paul Auster. The egg is named after the Hefra River, the mother river of Tevila.

items.name: Lyre
items.description: The lyre is one of the earliest plucked string instruments, often appearing as a symbol of music in the mythology of various nations in the Ocean Alliance. This particular lyre is an expensive custom collector's piece, made by a renowned luxury instrument workshop in Colom for its centennial celebration.

items.name: Heavenly Sphere
items.description: A precious collectible crafted by professional Eastern artisans. Its design is inspired by an important astronomical instrument from an ancient Eastern kingdom used for observing celestial phenomena. The dragon-shaped base supporting the armillary sphere represents the eight mountain pillars that hold up the sky in Eastern mythology.

items.name: Peacock Fan
items.description: A handheld fan handcrafted from peacock feathers, gold, and jewels. It was inspired by an ancient kingdom that revered peacocks. Legend has it that they used peacock feather fans as ceremonial regalia exclusively for the monarch, symbolizing royalty and protection.

items.name: Chaotic Matter
items.description: ■■■ is a non-Newtonian fluid-like energy-matter composite, adhered to the foundational space-time continuum of ■■■■. It manifests as a constantly surging dark luster. It possesses extremely powerful meme-distorting properties and can erode reality. Based on the conclusions of existing research papers, we theorize that ■■■ "edits" the laws of physics it comes into contact with, making them more unstable and susceptible to the observer's consciousness. There is now sufficient evidence to suggest ■■■ is the source and basic compositional material of the vast majority of strange phenomena recorded in ■■■■. To prevent the spread of this memetic hazard, we have named ■■■ "Chaotic Matter."

items.name: Spirit Photograph
items.description: A spirit photograph taken of ■■■■. The photo shows a strangely shaped humanoid creature. According to rumors, its true identity is that of an operator from a squad that was carrying out a ■■ mission in ■■■■.

items.name: Distorted Crystal
items.description: A Distorted Crystal found in the Distorted Valley. Its composition is similar to obsidian, but there's an apparently biological structure in its center. Using sliced sample analysis, we have confirmed traces of ■■■ in there, as well as some biological reactions. We theorize this is a metabolic byproduct of ■■■■ after it was distorted by ■■■.

items.name: Mystic Stone
items.description: A Mystic Stone found in the Distorted Valley. The back is engraved with a standard circular geometric pattern, while the front is etched with strange symbols of unknown meaning. We consulted the available literature and historical records but failed to find the meanings of these symbols. However, after ■■■ activated it, we were able to obtain some information on ■■■■ from the stone.

items.name: Amber Heart of Heaven
items.description: A large piece of meteorite with a smooth cross-section, small enough that an adult could hold it with both hands. It's entirely deep iron-gray in color and has a large, translucent, yellowish-brown crystal structure embedded in its center, which emits a warm, amber-like luster under light. After this meteorite was purchased at an auction by a wealthy Kamona merchant, it was named the "Amber Heart of Heaven."

items.name: Optoelectronic Hyperspace Model
items.description: A die-hard fan of Colom's sci-fi movies hired someone to create an optoelectronic model of a famous scene from a renowned sci-fi film about space travel. The model looks like the hyperspace shown in the movie.

items.name: "Destiny" Gold Clay Tablet
items.description: A massive sintered clay tablet, dark brown and with slightly chipped edges. Its surface is engraved with gold cuneiform and astrological symbols. There's an image of a prophet in the center, flanked by vivid, precise, golden reliefs of Aries and Taurus. Research indicates this tablet resembles the astronomical records of an ancient river valley civilization, making it one of humanity's earliest astronomy documents.

items.name: Star of Kamona Pendant
items.description: A necklace with several massive aquamarine gems as its centerpieces, accented by a multitude of crushed diamonds. The main gems are a translucent aquamarine hue, almost entirely free of impurities, while the tightly encircled diamonds create a layered halo effect. Legend has it that the aquamarine pieces came from a giant uncut gemstone, named "Mercury," that was unearthed in a Kamona mine and of a quality previously unseen in the region. A wealthy local merchant funded its cutting and polishing and commissioned a renowned jeweler to craft this necklace. Naming it the "Star of Kamona," the merchant intended it to be a symbol of home. However, ever since its creation, every one of its owners has been drawn into conflict and each time it changed hands, it was accompanied by struggle and ruin.

items.name: Broken TV
items.description: An old CRT television that can be turned on even when not plugged in to a power source. Once on, though, the screen is always in a state of malfunction, alternating between static and distorted images. Tests have shown that observers see subtly different things in the glitching footage.

items.name: Luminous Rose
items.description: A rose variant collected from the Distorted Valley. In the absence of light, its petals continuously emit a faint blue light, in a spectrum closely matching that of moonlight. After the flower is picked, the light shows no signs of fading. When one touches its petals, a fleeting, affectionate whisper can be heard in one's ear: "Darling."

items.name: Marionette
items.description: A finely crafted marionette, it can move its limbs without a person's input. The movements are minute and follow no discernible pattern, making it impossible to currently determine how it's moving. It's recommended that in the long term, it should be stored in a monitored environment. The tiny, carved features of the marionette's face bear a striking resemblance to a girl who went missing while traveling.

items.name: Stone Scale
items.description: A stone scale, nearly identical to the scale decoration atop the Devotion Statue. When tested, the trays on each side always remain level; placing different objects on them does not unbalance them. It can no longer actually weigh items. A microscopic line of text is engraved on the bottom of the trays: "It knows all and will happily share. We only need to make a fair trade."

items.name: Corrupted Clock
items.description: Is the countdown to the end or to a new beginning?

items.name: Double-Neck Lute
items.description: A rare double-necked lute carved entirely from a single piece of mammoth ivory. The body features intricate relief carvings depicting excerpts from the heroic epic of Ostur III from the era of the Tevilan Empire. This lute was originally a family heirloom of a fallen noble family in southern Tevila. It changed hands several times during the war before it eventually found its way into the Dark Zone. Rumor has it that the noble attempted to flee to Colom with the lute but was detained at a border checkpoint, separating the instrument from its owner. Due to its precious material and intricate craftsmanship, it continues to fetch an extremely high price on the black market.

items.name: Emerald Jade Flute
items.description: A transverse flute finely carved from a solid piece of emerald jade. The flute's body is translucent and smooth, with the edges of the embouchure and finger holes polished to perfection. Natural jade patterns can be faintly seen flowing like clouds. A collector in Kamona with a passion for Eastern music spent a fortune purchasing this flute from an Eastern country.

items.name: Caliburn Model
items.description: The fastest, strongest, and hottest ruler of Night City's roads. Even if it's just a model, Rayfield's high standards of excellence make it worth the money.

items.name: Voss' Journal
items.description: The journal of famed bunker survivalist Voss. Outlined within are instructions for constructing a personal underground shelter, a 180-day survival plan, guides on water filtration, and other tips and tricks for living under extreme conditions. Only a few copies of the journal have been printed, and it has only been distributed among select groups. The work is known for its unique titanium alloy cover.

items.name: Space Boy Comic
items.description: "Space Boy," a Colom superhero comic book. It tells the tale of an alien with superhuman abilities who joined the Earth Alliance and helped them avert galactic calamities.

items.name: Control Tower Codebook
items.description: A notebook found in the airport control tower. The sequence of numbers on its pages seems to be a code that might open a hidden path.

items.name: Improved Manufacturing Blueprint
items.description: A conventional manufacturing blueprint. The paper's edges are slightly curled, and several key parameters have been altered with correction tape. An essential material for conducting formula research at the Workbench in your Trophy Room. They can often be found in various document boxes, clothing, and drawers.

items.name: Dried Flower Bookmark
items.description: A handmade dried-flower bookmark, with carefully selected flowers and leaves meticulously sealed in transparent film. Two names are written in fine ink along the edge: Marta and Valentina. Marta had made this dried-flower bookmark for her friend, and the two had agreed that Valentina would come to pick it up the next day. That evening, however, there was an unusual howling outside the house. Marta set aside the finished bookmark to go see what it was; and never returned. The next day, Valentina also didn't show up as planned, and the bookmark remained right where it was, like an undelivered letter.

items.name: Bundle of Rice Paper
items.description: A bundle of rice paper. The paper is delicate and flexible, with slightly yellowing edges. Originally from an Eastern country, it made its way into Kamona through trade channels before eventually ending up in the Dark Zone.

items.name: Mutant Evolution Sketch
items.description: A hand-drawn sketch of a mutant's evolutionary process left behind by a Bay Area resident trapped at Guoyapos Airport. The drawing details the physical changes of the infected at different stages, as well as their complete form upon finally becoming a mutant. In a later investigation, a purge squad found the author of this sketch in front of a mirror in the airport restroom.

items.name: Report File
items.description: A zombie incident report stored in the Airport Control Tower. It details the precise location of the data storage device and the password required to access it.

items.name: Aerospace Navigator
items.description: A special navigation device once used in the Tevilan space program. This electromechanical analog computer uses an intricate system of gears, cams, and differentials to help spacecraft determine their position.

items.name: K7-L Cipher Machine
items.description: A famous cipher designed by the Colom Defense Intelligence Service. By integrating rotor and electronic technologies, its safety and convenience have both been significantly enhanced.

items.name: Three-Axis Gyro Controller Prototype
items.description: A miniature prototype of a three-axis gyroscope controller for aerospace use. The genuine device was used in Tevila's Blizzard space shuttle. As a prototype for a key component of a groundbreaking spacecraft, it is extremely valuable among elite collectors.

items.name: Handheld Receiver
items.description: A handheld receiver designed by Universal Communications. Due to its reliability and durability, many Colom soldiers purchase it with their own funds.

items.name: Handheld Salinity Meter
items.description: A handheld salinity meter developed with investment from Wyllie Co., capable of quickly measuring the salt concentration in a solution.

items.name: Handheld Calculator
items.description: A handheld calculator made by Chapman. It features a dark body, a monochrome LCD screen, and hard plastic keys for basic scientific calculations.

items.name: Military Tool Kit
items.description: A military tool kit, full of gear capable of solving a variety of battlefield emergencies.

items.name: Nonlinear Node Detector
items.description: A nonlinear node detector from Colom. It can be used during security checks to locate well-hidden electronic devices, such as bugs or cameras. When compared to a metal detector, it stands out for its ability to find objects hidden in walls.

items.name: T-147 Individual Communication Device
items.description: A small, portable radio issued by Tevila to its frontline troops. It grants access to FM and AM stations.

items.name: Prototype Calculation Module
items.description: A calculation module for the TESM-6 prototype computer produced by Svarog's military-industrial complex. It was once a contender for inclusion in Tevila's newest generation of supercomputers, but was beaten out in the final stages by a similar product produced by Omas' military-industrial complex. In the end, the TESM-6 project went bankrupt, and this module found its way onto the black market.

items.name: Petso
items.description: An extremely popular toy. Allows the user to raise an electronic pet within an egg-shaped game console.

items.name: Capsule TV
items.description: The Capsule TV is a brand-new smart TV. It's portable, has an HD display, and includes smart interaction features. It was once a major milestone for Global United Comms, part of their entry into the consumer entertainment market, but later on, increasingly fierce competition caused the Capsule TV to be pushed out by newer products. As a result, there aren't many units left, which have made them quite valuable to collectors.

items.name: Personal Digital Assistant
items.description: A personal digital assistant released by Universal Communications. It boasts solid sales figures in the Ocean Alliance.

items.name: MRID Clamshell Laptop
items.description: The first clamshell laptop introduced by MRID, and the world's first portable computer of its kind. It features a dark gray magnesium alloy body, with a rugged industrial design bearing the distinct mark of its era. Thanks to its sturdy magnesium alloy casing and solid-state storage technology, this machine was purchased by both the Colom military and the Colom Space Agency right after its launch, and used as onboard equipment for space shuttles executing low Earth orbit missions.

items.name: GU-470 Portable Recorder
items.description: The GU-470 portable home recorder produced by Universal Communications. Thanks to its comprehensive features and excellent design, it has seen good sales in the global home recorder market.

items.name: 12.7x99mm M2 Ammo
items.description: 12.7x99mm M2 ammunition.
